description:
Following the complexity-check evaluation of the top-20 functions at CC=14,
five functions were classified as "required complexity" - their branching is
inherent to the problem domain and cannot be meaningfully reduced without
adding indirection that hurts readability.

These should be added to pyproject.toml [tool.benchbox.complexity] exclude_functions
with rationale comments, matching the existing pattern established in previous batches.

Functions to exclude:
1. benchbox/cli/commands/show_plan.py:show_plan (CC=14)
   - Error handling (4 except branches) + 3-way format dispatch; irreducible for a CLI command
2. benchbox/cli/commands/tuning_group.py:_display_config_settings_table (CC=14)
   - Guard count proportional to number of config fields; no reducible structure
3. benchbox/core/query_plans/parsers/base.py:_harmonize_operator_type (CC=14)
   - 12-way keyword→enum mapping; branching count equals enum member count
4. benchbox/core/concurrency/analyzer.py:analyze_contention (CC=14)
   - Mutually-exclusive classification decision tree; genuinely a classifier
5. benchbox/core/metadata_primitives/complexity.py:__post_init__ (CC=14)
   - N independent field validation guards; inherent to dataclass validation

verifications.description: Complexity check still passes after adding exclusions
verifications.expected: PASSED: all functions within complexity limit

work_units.summary: Add 5 exclude_functions entries to pyproject.toml with rationale comments
